source.title: Asian Championship 2012 on October 5-7, 2012 in Diamond Hill, Kowloon, Hong Kong
source.content: The [Asian Championship 2012](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=AsianChampionship2012) will take place on October 5-7, 2012 in Diamond Hill, Kowloon, Hong Kong. Check out the [Asian Championship 2012 website](http://hkrcu.net/ac2012) for more information and registration.

translation.title: 2012 年亚洲锦标赛将于 10 月 5 至 7 日在香港九龙钻石山举行
